intentAndPurpose.intent: Precision range input with s/m/l geometry, continuous/range types, inside/outside knob styles, optional step ticks, and a value tooltip that follows the thumb.

props.name: ariaLabels
props.description: Per-thumb aria-label for range sliders (array indexed by thumb). Falls back to `aria-label` when absent. Use this only in range mode; for single-thumb sliders use `aria-label`.

props.name: end
props.description: Node rendered at the end of the slider (e.g. an IconButton). 24×24 slot per Figma.

props.name: knobStyle
props.description: Knob placement style. Default `inside` (Figma). Migration: the pre-conformance default was `outside`; pass it explicitly to retain the former appearance.

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: Called when the user releases / commits the value.

props.name: showSteps
props.description: Render tick marks at every step.

props.name: size
props.description: Figma size axis. Default `s`. Migration: the pre-conformance default was `m`; pass `size="m"` to retain it.

props.name: snapToSteps
props.description: When true (default), the thumb snaps to exact step positions. When false, dragging is continuous but tick marks still appear at step positions.

props.name: start
props.description: Node rendered at the start of the slider (e.g. an IconButton). 24×24 slot per Figma.

props.name: type
props.description: Slider value shape. When omitted, arrays keep the historical range behavior and scalar values resolve to `continuous`.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value (controlled). Number for single thumb, array for range.

interactionBehavior.summary: Slider is a Base UI slider whose thumb grows to an explicit active diameter on hover, drag, and keyboard focus — not a `scale()` squash, because Figma's +2/+4/+4 growth is not a constant ratio. A click on the track jumps the nearest thumb to that point and captures the pointer; a click on the thumb itself waits for movement. Keyboard arrows accelerate like a macOS slider, while `Home` / `End` still jump to the bounds through Base UI.
hover: Hover grows the knob dot from its idle diameter to the per-size active diameter (`--_knob-dot-active-size`), interpolating `width` / `height` rather than using `transform: scale()`.
Wrapped in `@media (hover: hover)`, so a touch tap never leaves a stuck grown knob.
In `showTooltip="auto"` (the default) the value bubble also appears above the knob (or to the right when vertical) on that same hover.
The rail and fill colours do not change on hover — only the knob diameter, plus the tooltip.
press: Pointer-down on the THUMB does not jump the value; it marks `[data-knob-active]` / `[data-dragging]`, switches the cursor to `grabbing`, and grows the dot to the same active diameter as hover.

Pointer-down on the TRACK (the Control, including empty rail) immediately sets the nearest enabled thumb to that point (`trackPress`) and then captures the pointer for the drag. Range sliders pick the closest thumb by midpoint distance.
The Control calls `setPointerCapture` on the pointer id, so the drag keeps updating if the finger leaves the track.
`snapToSteps` (default `true`) uses `step` as the drag increment. `snapToSteps={false}` uses `min(step, (max-min)/1000)` so dragging is nearly continuous; keyboard still uses the real `step`.

In `showTooltip="auto"` the value bubble is also shown throughout the drag, not only on hover/focus: `[data-dragging]` on the thumb is one of its visibility triggers (alongside `[data-open]`, `:has(:focus-visible)`, and forced states), so the current value stays readable while the finger or cursor moves.
`onValueCommitted` fires on pointer-up / pointer-cancel, which also clears `activeKnobIndex` so the knob shrinks back and the drag-driven bubble hides.
focus: Keyboard focus grows the knob to the active diameter and draws the two-layer halo on the DOT: `--Stroke-XL` gap in `--Surface-Halo-Gap` plus an outer ring in `--Informative-Bold` (always Informative, not the slider's appearance role).
The halo is `:has(:focus-visible)` on the thumb, so a mouse click that focuses the hidden range input does not paint it.
In `showTooltip="auto"` the bubble also appears for `:focus-visible`. `showTooltip="always"` pins it open via `[data-open]`; `false` omits the bubble entirely.
keyboard: A capture-phase handler on the thumb input intercepts `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` (horizontal) or `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` (vertical), `PageUp` / `PageDown`, and `Shift+Arrow`. It `preventDefault`s and `stopPropagation`s so ancestors never see those keys.
First presses move by `step`. Held repeats accelerate: ×2 after 4 repeats, ×5 after 12, then `largeStep` (default 10) after 24. `Shift` and `PageUp` / `PageDown` always use `largeStep`.
`Home` / `End` are NOT intercepted — Base UI jumps to `min` / `max`, or to the neighbouring thumb minus `minStepsBetweenValues` in range mode.

On a horizontal slider, `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` fall through the acceleration hook (it returns without preventing) and Base UI steps them by Root's `step` prop — that is `dragStep`, so with `snapToSteps={false}` those keys use the fine increment, not the public `step`. The same applies to `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` on a vertical slider.
`readOnly` keeps the thumb focusable and sets `aria-readonly`, but cancels Base UI's change (`eventDetails.cancel()`) and does not attach the accelerator. `disabled` does not attach it either.
disabled: `disabled` dims the root to `--Disabled-Opacity` and sets `cursor: not-allowed`. The Control and the hidden range input get `pointer-events: none`.
The not-allowed cursor is declared on the root, which is not the natively disabled input, so it is observable — this is not the Button-style cursor gap.
`readOnly` is a separate axis: it does not dim, does not set `pointer-events: none`, and stays in the tab order; it only rejects value changes.
touch: The thumb hit target is `--Spacing-12` (48px) regardless of knob size, so the visual dot can be 2px while the finger still has a 48×48 target.
The root and Control set `touch-action: none` so a drag does not scroll the page.
Hover growth is `(hover: hover)`-guarded; a touch drag still grows the knob via `[data-knob-active]` / `[data-dragging]`, which are not hover-gated.
